Both chambers organize through multiparty coalitions.

16 senators elected in 2024 remain. Secondary-source split, consistent with 5 D / 12 R contested and 15 D / 18 R overall.

Current candidate table, which warns that it may be incomplete. Independent opposition handled separately in districts 1 and 9. District 15 independent vote splitting remains a limitation.
Syndicated author assessment. Qualitative and stale: retained for comparison only; no numerical probability conversion.
